name: The Caretaker's Letter
description: Your caretaker's last letter sends you to Rosie Lockwood, the Keywarden of the Burrowlock in Millhaven, who has held your inheritance in trust. Claim it, then get yourself ready for the road.

start_condition.start_hint: Every new character who starts in Millhaven begins with this, from their caretaker's letter.

hub.text: Rosie looks up from her keys with a smile like an open door. "Well now, what can I do for you, dear?"

inherit.label: My caretaker left something here for me.
inherit.text: Rosie reads the letter with one hand over her heart. "Oh, my dear. Oh, I am sorry." She dabs her eyes with a corner of her apron and reaches for her ring of keys. "Every harvest, a little something, and a note: for the child. I kept it dry and I kept it counted. Your sigil's on the lock, so there's no mistaking whose it is." "And your caretaker's savings, dear, and your Homeward Stone, on its own little key ring. They had it fitted the year you were born."

ask-sigil.label: How did you know it was me?
ask-sigil.text: "Everyone's born with a true sigil, dear, as plain as a nose and twice as hard to change. Can't be faked, can't be swapped. The Burrowlock's deep doors only turn for the sigil they were cut for."

ask-caretaker.label: Did you know my caretaker?
ask-caretaker.text: "Lovely hands for bread, terrible hands for knots. They'd sit right where you're standing and tell me about you. Every year: taller, cleverer, more stubborn." She laughs. "I could tell they were proud."

ask-stone.label: What is a Homeward Stone?
ask-stone.text: "Your Homeward Stone, dear. Give it a squeeze and think of home, and it'll pop you back to the waystone by the well. It needs a week's rest after, so save it for when you need it. Your caretaker wanted you always able to find your way back."

take.label: I'd like to see it.
take.text: Rosie turns three keys in three locks. "There we are. And I've put a little something extra in, preserves, don't argue."

skip.label: I've done this before. Just the gear, please.
skip.text: "In a hurry? Off you go, then, dear." She turns the keys.

vault.label: Could you open my vault?
vault.text: Rosie turns the deep locks. "There you are. Take what you need. Anything you leave down here is safe, and any keeper who's accepted you can open it for you, wherever you end up."

supplies.label: Where can I buy supplies for the road?
supplies.text: "Pip Haversham's shop is just across the square. Haversham's General Store. Buy something for the road, dear. You never know when you'll want a candle."

lessons.label: Is there anything else I should do first?
lessons.text: "Your caretaker mentions lessons. If you've a bit of magic in you, get it ready before you need it: open your Spells & Abilities and put a spell in a slot. Same as packing a lunch."

bed.label: Where should I sleep tonight?
bed.text: "Marigold Sweetwater keeps the Grain & Grape, out on the Eastern Farms. Take a room and get some sleep, and she'll feed you in the morning. Then save your game, dear, write it all down, so nothing's lost. Then come and see me."

completed.option: Thank you for keeping it safe.

after.text: "There you are, all rested!" Rosie beams. "When you want work, come to me. All us keepers post the bounties, a new one every day and every week. And if you pass the old waystone, give it a pat. It's looking peaky, poor thing."

village-shopkeeper.option: I'm new in town. What do I need for the road?

advice.text: "Oh, rations, definitely rations!" Pip beams and pats a neat little stack. "A whole day's food in each, and they keep forever. When your tummy rumbles and you're Hungry, right-click one in your bag and Eat. Never go anywhere without at least two, my mum always said."

how-buy.label: How do I buy something?
how-buy.text: "Easy! Have a look at the shelves, then right-click what you'd like: Buy 1, or Buy X for a few. Click anything to see its price, all clearly marked. And if you've things to sell, the Sell tab's the other side: pop them on the counter."

room.text: "A room's for one night, dear!" Marigold bustles over. "Pay me, pop up to your room, and you can sleep any time after nine. Breakfast's with it, so you'll wake up well fed, and check-out's at ten. I'll have the kettle on."

stages.description: Your caretaker left you a letter. Read it: right-click it in your bag and choose Read.
stages.tip: Items have actions: right-click one (long-press on a phone) to see what you can do with it. Your next step always shows in the quest tracker over the scene, and the Quest Log has the rest.

stages.description: The letter sends you to Rosie Lockwood, the Keywarden, at the Burrowlock in the Village Center. Go inside and talk to them.
stages.tip: Buildings are listed under Buildings: click one to go in. Inside, the People column shows who's there; click someone to talk. Time stands still while you talk.

objectives.description: Talk to Rosie Lockwood at the Burrowlock.

stages.description: Rosie has held your inheritance in trust. Ask for it, and choose what suits you.
stages.tip: Ask the keeper for it, then choose one option on each screen. Tap ? on any item to see what it does: damage, armor, weight, value. Once it's yours, what you can wear you'll be wearing: check the Equipment tab, and what you carry in Inventory.

objectives.description: Take up your inheritance from Rosie.

stages.description: Your caretaker's savings and your Homeward Stone are in your vault. Ask Rosie to open it, and take both out.
stages.tip: Your vault is one store shared across the realm: deposit here, withdraw in any city whose keeper has accepted you. What's in it is safe, even if you fall. In the vault window, click an item to take it (set the amount first: 1, 5, 10 or ALL), or drag it into your bag. Gold has weight, so carry what you'll spend and leave the rest here. Your Homeward Stone: right-click → Use to return to your city's waystone, then it rests for a week.

objectives.description: Take your gold from the vault.
Take your Homeward Stone from the vault.

stages.description: Buy something for the road. Pip Haversham keeps Haversham's General Store in the Village Center; any shop will do.
stages.tip: Shops: talk to the shopkeeper and browse. To buy, right-click an item → Buy 1 or Buy X (click it to see the price; your Charisma helps). To sell, open the Sell tab, click your items to put them on the counter, then confirm the sale. Rations are food that never spoils: when you're Hungry, right-click one → Eat. Your bag: the 4 general slots are your belt, the things you can reach in a fight; the darker slots are your backpack. Drag items onto a container (backpack, pouch) to put them in, or right-click it → Open. Bag full? Use your backpack, or leave things in the vault.

objectives.description: Buy supplies at Haversham's General Store.

stages.description: If you learned magic, have it ready before you need it. Open Spells & Abilities and prepare a spell in a slot.
stages.tip: Spells & Abilities: your spell slots are at the top, the spells you know below. Click an empty slot to choose a spell for it. Cantrips are ready at once; a levelled spell takes an hour per level to prepare, and the clock has to run. Spells cost mana, and some need runes or components. In a fight you cast from the combat bar. Outside one, right-click a prepared spell → Cast: that works for spells that heal, cure, create something or leave a lasting effect.

stages.description: Take a room at the Grain & Grape Inn in the Eastern Farms and sleep. Inns serve breakfast, so you'll wake well fed. Then save your game: there's no autosave, so a save is how you keep what you've done.
stages.tip: Inns: talk to the innkeeper to rent a room (one night, breakfast included, check-out at 10 AM), go into your room (Rooms), then Sleep, any time after 9 PM. Sleep is what clears fatigue; 🕐 Wait only passes the time. Saving: Settings → Save game, or Ctrl+S. There's no autosave, so closing the game takes you back to your last save.

objectives.description: Sleep at the Grain & Grape Inn.

stages.description: Go back to Rosie at the Burrowlock and tell them you're settled.
stages.tip: Vault keepers post the realm's bounties, a new one every day and every week: ask any keeper for work.
